title: "Privacy"
description: "What information this site collects, why, and your choices."

Last updated: 26 September 2026.

This page explains what information Data Insight collects on this website, how it is used, and the choices you have. Data Insight is an initiative of [aai-services](https://github.com/aai-services). Questions can be sent through the [contact page](contact.qmd).

## What we collect

This site has no user accounts. We collect personal information only when you give it to us:

- **Applications and forms.** When you apply to the program, submit a project, or contact us, the form stores what you enter, such as your name, email address, and answers. We use it only to review your application, respond to you, and run the program. The forms are hosted by Tally, which stores submissions on our behalf.
- **Project submissions.** Projects you publish on this site appear with the name you choose to show. They stay public unless you ask us to remove them.

We do not sell personal information.

## Advertising and cookies

This site shows ads from Google AdSense, which help cover hosting and program costs. Ads do not appear on the application, contact, or privacy pages.

- Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your previous visits to this website or other websites.
- Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visits to this site and other sites on the internet.
- You can opt out of personalized advertising in [Google's Ads Settings](https://adssettings.google.com), or opt out of some third-party vendors' use of cookies at [www.aboutads.info](https://www.aboutads.info).
- Visitors in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, and Switzerland are asked for consent before personalized ads are shown.

For more detail, see [how Google uses information from sites that use its services](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites).

## Other services this site uses

- **Hosting.** The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub may log visitors' IP addresses for security; see the [GitHub General Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).
- **Fonts.** Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives your IP address when a page loads.
- **Donations.** Donations are processed by the platform you choose, such as Buy Me a Coffee, PayPal, or GitHub Sponsors. We receive the details that platform shares, such as your name and any message you leave; we never see your payment card details.

## Your choices

You can ask us to see, correct, or delete the information you gave us through a form, or to remove a project you published, by writing to us through the [contact page](contact.qmd).

## Changes

If this policy changes, the date at the top of this page will change too.
